Sonam Wangchuk calls for July 20 march to Parliament

Activist Sonam Wangchuk has announced a march from Jantar Mantar to Parliament in Delhi on July 20, coinciding with the monsoon session. He has appealed to people to join the protest in the capital. The march aims to draw attention to specific issues, though the exact nature of these issues is not detailed in the provided coverage.
